chunks: Al-Sadiq عليه السلام was asked about a man who goes out accompanying his brother for the distance of two or three days. He said: “If it is in the month of Ramadan, then let him break his fast.”

Then he was asked: “Which of the two is better: that he stays and fasts, or that he accompanies him?” He said: “He should accompany him. Indeed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has lifted fasting from him when he accompanies him.”

key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the month of Ramadan, during which fasting is obligatory
key_terms.فَلْيُفْطِرْ: then he should break the fast
key_terms.يُشَيِّعُ: to accompany or see someone off on a journey

ai.seo_question: Is it better to remain and fast in Ramadan or travel to accompany a fellow believer?
ai.summary: This hadith explains that if a person travels to accompany his brother for a journey of two or three days during the month of Ramadan, he should break his fast. It further states that accompanying his brother is preferable to remaining behind to fast, because Allah عزّ وجلّ has exempted him from fasting in that circumstance.
